facts.text: John acknowledges that self-doubt was one of the most challenging obstacles he faced during his journey.

evidence.quote: There were moments when I questioned if I was on the right track.
I can imagine those hurdles were tough to deal with, especially the self-doubt.

facts.text: John attributes his success to support from loved ones and his own perseverance.

evidence.quote: With support at home and my own grit, I powered through.
Having support and believing in myself really helped me out.

facts.text: John mentions that his family is an important part of his journey and provides him with trust and support.

evidence.quote: I'm really lucky to have my family on this journey with me.
Support from loved ones is vital. With their trust, we can do anything!
